description: Synthetic Food/Medicine/Cosmetics image corpus for the SG-029 metered baseline and the SG-036 cosmetics extension. Ground truth is authored from the committed render recipe (generate.py); Food/Medicine provider_output caches are written by the one metered SG-029 run and scored offline thereafter, while the SG-036 cosmetics provider_output entries are authored offline references (no live call in SG-036).
